data.narrative:
Stegra, a Growth-stage climate and energy company founded by Carl-Erik Lagercrantz and Harald Mix, has raised over $7.0B to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), including companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set—fewer than three datapoints meet stage and valuation-tier filters.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology provides the primary valuation signal. Using total capital raised ($7.0B) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $8.4B. Conservative and optimistic scenarios around this anchor—anchored to typical variance in stage-progression multipliers—produce a low estimate of $7.1B and a high estimate of $9.7B, respectively.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $7.1B to $9.7B, with a median of $8.4B. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer validation and reliance on total raised as a valuation proxy, which may not fully reflect recent financing dynamics or sector-specific return expectations. Additional comparable data or recent financing round terms would strengthen conviction in this range.
